summary: The project aims to design a remote control with a minimal design, using a small joystick, LCD, and a few buttons for navigation, featuring a novelty transmitter for location. The design will be adventurous, ergonomic for both left and right-handed people, with a soft touch and organic feel using rubber. The remote control will have a joystick, two function buttons, LCD, customizable menu structure, on-board memory, and a cable for computer connection. The case will likely be made of plastic, with conventional batteries as a probable power source, targeting people under 60.
